ownerDependency: VY1 builtin admission method naming / shared trust-inventory integration

entries.code: def Builtin.admit {a r : Nat} (tier : Tier) (b : Builtin a r) : Except Refusal Unit :=
b.admit tier = .ok () ↔ BuiltinP tier b := by
change ((b.admit tier >>= fun _ => allFin _ (fun i => checkExpr tier (args i))) = .ok ()) ↔ _

rationale: Six exact ordinary .admit method occurrences, not Lean admit tactics. Builtin.admit returns Except Refusal Unit and is implemented by tier/resource/callcode checks. No proof term construction, axiom, sorry, Meta admission, unsafe or override. Existing checker and forbidden-token rules unchanged. Registration is private integration only; main shared inventory untouched.
